admissionInfo.note: This program uses a merit-based, competitive admission process.
admissionInfo.text: Matriculation requirements are designed to ensure applicants who are admitted into the OTA program can be successful and meet the rigor required of the technical classes. This program uses a merit-based, competitive admission process. Applications may be submitted prior to the completion of the prerequisite courses listed below, but the students must complete all prerequisite courses prior to starting the OTA program and have obtained a C (74%) or better in all the courses. Matriculation Requirements: Be admitted to Utah Valley University. Minimum GPA of 3.0 in prerequisite courses (no grades below C) General education coursework complete, in addition to the following courses: ZOOL 2320 , ZOOL 2325 , ZOOL 2420 , ZOOL 2425 , OT 1010 , and HLTH 1300 . Related observation, volunteer, or work experience (12 hours minimum in more than 1 practice setting) Upon acceptance into the program, students are required to obtain and maintain the following: Criminal background check Health/immunization requirements CPR certification Drug screening
